title: Senior Backend Developer (Mobile APIs)
text:
Demo Co. Hazel is an agency building education apps. We are looking for a senior-level Backend Developer (Mobile APIs) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Oldmoor.

Our stack: python, go. You will ship features end to end, own the release process and work closely with design and product.

Regular hack days. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
